Ok so I played the app and here's what I discovered. It's a little wierd.

If Omnitron has been dealt 7 or more damage already in the round and then one of his components is played then the component is not auto destroyed. HOWEVER, it does track the damage dealt so far that round. The card will only get detroyed when a damage event happens, though. Dealing damage is the trigger for the destruction check. So if Omnitron takes 1 more damage the component will be destroyed.

I've tested it several times now.

So, that being said, here are the implications for the Bloodsworn Colosseum titles:

1. If a Reckless comes into play and a target has already dealt itself 3 damage in the turn the target may not claim Reckless. However, if it deals itself any more damage at all then the condition check will trigger and then it is claimed.

2. If a the third target in a turn being destroyed causes Champion to be played then all 3 targets do count toward the 3 targets in a turn. However, the title cannot be claimed until a another target is destroyed while the title is face-up.

3. Similar timing and triggering applies for Mindbreaker, Chaos Lord, Indiscriminant, and other titles.

posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
All things track backwards except Omnitron's components and Rooftop Combat (which are treated as if they had "since this card entered play" text, but those cards are already overly full of text). They start counting HP once they enter play. So, yes, you can claim Titles as they enter play if you did the required action THAT turn. And yes, Coolant Blast does count any applicable damage that was dealt before it entered play.

I hope this is more helpful than it is confusing.

It's a little wierd.If Omnitron has been dealt 7 or more damage already in the round and then one of his components is played then the component is not auto destroyed. HOWEVER, it does track the damage dealt so far that round. The card will only get detroyed when a damage event happens, though. Dealing damage is the trigger for the destruction check. So if Omnitron takes 1 more damage the component will be destroyed.I've tested it several times now.So, that being said, here are the implications for the Bloodsworn Colosseum titles:1. If a Reckless comes into play and a target has already dealt itself 3 damage in the turn the target may not claim Reckless. However, if it deals itself any more damage at all then the condition check will trigger and then it is claimed.2. If a the third target in a turn being destroyed causes Champion to be played then all 3 targets do count toward the 3 targets in a turn. However, the title cannot be claimed until a another target is destroyed while the title is face-up.3. Similar timing and triggering applies for Mindbreaker, Chaos Lord, Indiscriminant, and other titles. 

Just to clarify: do the title cards need to trigger in this way or is that just a "bug" in the app, and titles like Reckless, Chaos Lord etc. go under a target the moment they are flipped (if the requirement has already been met that turn)?

If more than one target has met that requirement that turn, do you pick the target that met that requirement first?

Also, Mindbreaker. If Mindbreaker definitely "looks back" at all damage dealt to all in a round, I will probably always house rule that it has an invisible "since this card entered play" text. Sometimes too much recollection=too much mind breaking.
